news.title: Two women injured after stabbing in northwest Atlanta, police say
news.summary: Atlanta police said two women were taken to a hospital after a reported stabbing Saturday evening. The investigation remains ongoing.

news.title: Boy killed in late-night southeast Atlanta shooting, police say
news.summary: A boy was killed late Friday night following a shooting in southeast Atlanta, according to police.

news.title: Man found shot to death near Historic Fourth Ward Park, police say
news.summary: Atlanta police are investigating after a man was shot and killed early Saturday morning near the Historic Fourth Ward Park.

news.title: Father of suspect in Smyrna dismemberment case releases statement
news.summary: The father of an 18-year-old man charged with murder in Smyrna has released a statement pointing to his son's history of mental illness while police disclose new timeline details in the case.

news.title: Community mourns 2 boys slain in shooting
news.summary: Friends and family remembered two young brothers who were shot to death outside their DeKalb County apartment.

news.title: 2 arrested after Rockdale SWAT finds 10 pounds of marijuana, stolen guns
news.summary: Two people are in custody after a SWAT raid uncovered drugs and stolen weapons at a home, the Rockdale County Sheriff's Office posted on social media Friday night.

news.title: Ex-Cartersville officer accused of stealing money from evidence room
news.summary: A former Cartersville police officer is behind bars after state investigators said she stole money from the department's evidence room.

news.title: Man shot during dispute in northwest Atlanta, police say
news.summary: A man is in the hospital after being shot early Saturday morning in northwest Atlanta following a dispute, according to police.

news.title: Police investigate after man found shot at Mechanicsville gas station
news.summary: A 60-year-old man is in the hospital after being found with a gunshot wound at a Mechanicsville gas station, according to police.

news.title: Man faces charges after SWAT response in Rockdale County, deputies say
news.summary: A man faces pending charges after triggering a SWAT response and a search on Friday night in Rockdale County, according to the sheriff's office.
